deps.edn.reason: The git floors and pins on repositories that are bundled here become local roots so the same namespaces are not loaded twice. The other sections are unchanged. JVM-only Maven dependencies and aliases are removed (alias :gen-wit, alias :check-wit, alias :test reduced to :extra-paths, alias :lint): the official CD/CI path is Amu selfhost and Kotoba native, and any other runner is an oracle that is not part of the package.

nbb.edn.reason: The same git floors as deps.edn are resolved through the bundled libraries by kbb from lib/; the file keeps only the paths.

src/kami/app_fixtures.cljk.reason: Monorepo namespace disambiguation (2026-10-27): this file is the EDN authority catalog loader for resources/kami/app_fixtures.edn, but it declared the same ns as lib/kotoba.kamiAppFixtures/src/kami/app_fixtures.cljk (duplicate active host source). Renamed to kami.app-fixtures-catalog (the -catalog suffix matches the sibling kami.provider-catalog); the filename is kept because imported paths must stay present.

test/kami/app_fixtures_test.cljk.reason: Test follows the src rename: ns kami.app-fixtures-catalog-test, require kami.app-fixtures-catalog (was kami.app-fixtures-test / kami.app-fixtures, colliding with lib/kotoba.kamiAppFixtures test ns).

test/kami/component_test.cljk.reason: The suite opens fixture files by a path relative to the old repository root (test/...). The library suites run from the root of this repository, so each such path names the file where it now lives (lib/kotoba.kamiContracts/test/...). Nothing else in the file changes.
